interventionGates.minimumSignal: at least 3 observed paid transactions across active channels
ifBelow: do not increase paid SKU production rate
prioritize one canonical acquisition funnel per paid category
audit titles, previews, search intent, and buyer problem
keep entry products but raise future substantial note practical content toward 980-1480 JPY when justified

interventionGates.minimumSignal: at least 5000 JPY monthly net run-rate or equivalent repeated purchase signal
ifBelow: concentrate on the top two demand categories
evaluate one external distribution/affiliate setup with low recurring cost
request analytics setup only if the expected learning value exceeds user setup burden

interventionGates.minimumSignal: at least 10000 JPY monthly net run-rate
ifBelow: treat organic BOOTH/note-only strategy as insufficient
test a materially different acquisition channel or buyer segment
evaluate organization-license positioning for suitable practical tools
consider productized high-value offers only if delivery can stay low-touch

interventionGates.minimumSignal: at least 20000 JPY monthly net run-rate
ifBelow: pivot portfolio toward proven search demand and higher willingness-to-pay problems
stop weak categories rather than maintaining them
consider cross-platform English localization only for products with real domestic demand
do not compensate for weak economics by mass-producing more low-value items

productionCaps.reason: prevent quality dilution and shift capacity toward discovery, funnel improvement, bundles, and winner expansion
